statement: For simple complex A of dimension2 or3 with End(A)=Z and primitive rank-one NS type(1,d2,...,e), Fourier images of curves supported in translates of proper abelian subvarieties of A x Adual have exact lattice Z D + kappa(e) Z P + Z Ddual, where kappa(e)=product ell^ceil(v_ell(e)/2)
depends_on: Beauville1983 Proposition1; Grabowski2004 Corollary3.1.9; integral Riemann forms; explicit rank determinant
notes: A restriction on a specified source of curves, not a counterexample to the full direct-summand assertion.
